Component Type Approval (CTA)

Application for Component Type Approval (CTA) aims to ensure that every component / automotive system that has been gazetted in the Customs Order (Prohibition on Import) for domestic supply and sale complies with the mandatory standards that have been set as in the Table below.

BIL.COMPONENTREGULATORY 
1.Protective HelmetR22 Protective Helmets and Their Visors for Driver and Passengers of Motorcycles and Moped
Malaysia Standard (MS) 1: Protective Helmets for Vehicle Users
2.Child Seat / Child Restraint SystemR44 Child Restraint Systems
R129 Enhanced Child Restraint Systems (ECRS)
3.New Brake Lining or Brake PadR90 Replacement braking
4.New Pneumatic Tyres & New Retreaded Pneumatic Tyres R54 Tyres for commercial vehicles and their trailers
R108 Retreaded tyres for passenger cars and their trailers
R109 Retreaded tyres for commercial vehicles and their trailers
MS ISO 1394:2017 New pneumatic tyres for highway vehicles other than passenger cars – specifications (second revision)
MS ISO 149:2018 New pneumatic passenger car tyres – specifications (third revision)
MS ISO 224:2005 ,AMD. 1:2010 Retreaded pneumatic rubber tyres for passengger cars and commercial vehicles – specifications (second revision)
5.Speed Monitoring DeviceR39 Speedometer
6.Gas Discharge Headlamp / BulbR98 Headlamps with gas-discharge light sources
R99 Gas-discharge light sources
MS ISO 303:2004 Installation of lighting and light signalling devices for motor vehicles and their trailers
7.SeatR17 Strength of seats, their anchorages and head restraints
R25 Head restraints (headrests)
8.Safety SeatbeltsR16 Safety-belts
9.Rear View Mirrors For Motor VehicleR46 Devices for indirect vision and of motor vehicles
10.Headlamp For Motor VehiclesR112 Motor vehicles headlamps emitting an asymmetrical passing beam
11.Safety Glass for Motor VehiclesR43 Safety Glazing material and their installation on vehicles

CTA Guidelines 2020

CTA APPLICATION FORM 2021.rev0
